   298→/**
   299→ * Deduplicate outfit categories by keeping the best-scoring item per category
   300→ * Ensures only ONE item per category (outerwear, bottom, dress, etc.)
   301→ */
   302→export function deduplicateOutfitCategories(
   303→  items: Product[],
   304→  outfitContext: {
   305→    aesthetic?: AestheticCategory
   306→    colorPalette?: ColorPalette
   307→    occasion?: OccasionType | 'casual'
   308→  } = {}
   309→): Product[] {

   311→  const categoryMap = new Map<string, Product[]>()
   312→
   313→  for (const item of items) {
   314→    const category = getProductCategory(item)
   315→    if (!categoryMap.has(category)) {
   316→      categoryMap.set(category, [])
   317→    }
   318→    categoryMap.get(category)!.push(item)
   319→  }
   320→
   321→  // For each category, keep only the best-scoring item
   322→  const deduplicated: Product[] = []
   323→
   324→  for (const [category, products] of Array.from(categoryMap.entries())) {
   325→    if (products.length === 1) {
   326→      // Check for gender-inappropriate items even if only one
   327→      const product = products[0]
   328→      const productCategory = (product as any).category?.toLowerCase() || ''
   329→      const hasMenCategory = productCategory.includes('men') && !productCategory.includes('women')
   330→
   331→      if (hasMenCategory) {

   337→      }
   338→
   339→      deduplicated.push(product)
   340→    } else if (products.length > 1) {
   341→      // Multiple items in same category - keep the best one
   342→      const scored = products.map(p => ({
   343→        product: p,
   344→        score: scoreProductForOutfit(p, outfitContext),
   345→      }))
   346→
   347→      // Sort by score descending
   348→      scored.sort((a, b) => b.score - a.score)
   349→
   350→      // Keep the highest scoring item
   351→      const kept = scored[0].product
   352→      const removed = scored.slice(1).map(s => s.product)
   353→
   354→      console.log(`[OutfitValidator] Removed duplicate ${category}:`, {
   355→        kept: `${kept.name} (score: ${scored[0].score.toFixed(1)})`,
   356→        removed: removed.map(p => p.name),
   357→      })
   358→
   359→      deduplicated.push(kept)
   360→    }
   361→  }
   362→
   363→  return deduplicated
   364→}
